title: Thesis Agency Alternatives for Brand Film and Meta Creative
summary: Thesis agency alternatives for brand film and Meta creative: Knowlify first, then MuteSix, Biddyco, Pilothouse Studios and Voy Media, checked October 2026.
body_markdown:
Knowlify is our top pick if the job is a steady flow of AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, not brand strategy or live-action film. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared. Thesis describes itself as an independent creative agency in Portland, Oregon, with work across brand strategy, film, motion and photography. Which alternative fits depends on whether you are buying one brand piece or a stream of performance ads.


## What does Thesis offer, and what does its site leave out?


Thesis's homepage, checked October 2026, sorts its work into three areas. Create covers brand strategy, experiences and campaigns. Craft covers design, film, motion and photography. Scale covers scaling content through design, social and marketing systems.[Thesis](https://thesis.agency/) The page shows a strip of well-known brand logos but no case studies, so its client fit is implied rather than stated.


The page does not state client size, minimums, retainers or pricing, and it does not mention Meta or paid media. Before you compare, ask Thesis directly whether it buys media, what a typical scope costs and how revisions are counted.


## Which alternative fits which part of the job?


The table lists each option's own published terms, as of October 2026, with Knowlify first.


Option Published starting point What it covers Better for


Knowlify From $5,000 a month Finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, about 25 a week, optional Meta campaign management A steady flow of performance video ads


MuteSix (Bespoke Production) Not published; entry-level option with a dedicated creative director Storyboarding, live action, animation, CGI and post-production Custom production that includes live action


Biddyco Not published Hand-built motion, kinetic type and animation over creator footage Motion-led ads for brands spending heavily on Meta


Pilothouse Studios Retainers, performance incentives or project scopes; no figures Direct response ads, commercials, explainers and creator content DTC ecommerce brands that want media and creative from one team


Voy Media Creative Studio Packages based on total ad spend; no figures UGC, at-home creator videos and studio production with script, talent and art direction Creator and studio work tied to a Facebook ad program


Thesis's strength is brand work, so most of these alternatives are performance-led. Compare them on the output you need, not on the agency's size.


## Knowlify: our top pick for Meta video volume


Knowlify is the best fit when what you are replacing is the weekly ad output, not the brand work. It delivers about 25 finished Facebook and Instagram ads a week, the first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. Its three formats are AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation and AI commercials, so a brand that already has its identity can turn it into a testing queue of presenter ads, animated characters and product scenes. You can buy creative only, or add end-to-end Meta campaign management.


Pricing is a custom quote. For a brand testing a second vendor alongside its agency, the 90-day guarantee lowers the risk: cancel by email for a full refund if the ads have not made more than you paid (terms on the site, see[pricing and guarantee](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Our[video ad production](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) page covers the scope.


When to pick another option: Knowlify does not list brand strategy among its services, so it does not replace a brand team, and it does not supply real human creators or run TikTok, Google or YouTube ads.


### MuteSix: custom production with live action


If you are leaving Thesis for film, MuteSix is the closest listed option. Its Bespoke Production page covers storyboarding, live action, animation, CGI and post-production, with an entry-level option that includes a dedicated creative director.[MuteSix Bespoke Production](https://mutesix.com/services/bespoke-production/) A production-only package exists for brands that buy media elsewhere, so you can commission the film without handing over your media. Pricing, minimums and headquarters are not published.


### Biddyco: motion-led ads for Meta


Biddyco is a creative agency for brands spending between $100k and $5M a month on Meta. It covers concepting, scripting, creator sourcing, editing and animation across UGC, UGC with motion, motion, and static or GIF ads.[Biddyco](https://www.biddyco.com/) It does not describe running campaigns, and pricing is not published. Treat it as the motion-led option for performance pieces, not a stand-in for a long-form brand film.


### Pilothouse Studios: when media and creative sit together


Pilothouse Studios is the service line of Pilothouse Digital for direct response ads, commercials, explainer videos and motion graphics, plus creator content from in-house creators and a creator network.[Pilothouse](https://www.pilothouse.co/) Pilothouse says it is built for established, ambitious DTC ecommerce brands, and it prices through monthly retainers, performance-based incentives and custom project scopes, with no minimum spend published. Ask whether the studio can be hired without the media service.


### Voy Media Creative Studio: studio and creator production


Voy Media's Creative Studio page lists UGC, at-home creator videos, full studio production with script, talent and art direction, photography and influencer partnerships.[Voy Media Creative Studio](https://voymedia.com/services/creative-studio/) Its pricing page says packages are based on total ad spend, optimizations and growth, and it shows no figures.[Voy Media pricing](https://voymedia.com/pricing/) Voy Media presents itself as a Facebook advertising agency, so the studio is most useful if you also want it to run the ads.
